Sources: supplied updated paper pp. 5-9, State of the Art pp. 10-13, tym-corpus-app/src/Tym.Corpus.Api and TypeScript frontend source. Current analysis uses lexical candidates, sentence rules and an existing segment-mode model. It has no event coreference, actor identity resolution, full interval closure or automatic causal relation extraction. The validator checks schema, typed endpoints, source hash/span validity and limited strict-cycle/simultaneous contradictions. Human edits never automatically become human_gold.
Collect adjudicated annotations from independent narratives in both languages.
Keep parallel translations, chapters from one work and synthetic descendants in the same split group.
Report accuracy, macro F1 and per-class precision/recall. Add segment-boundary and temporal-graph evaluation.
Compare the lexical baseline with contextual and sequence models after implementing and evaluating them.
Human gold is the prerequisite for a generalization claim
